messages:
vikram: Quick sync — CloudShelf just signed for a joint marketplace listing + co-marketing push. want to lock a 6-week plan. key pieces: launch post, benchmark narrative, 1 webinar, inbound lead routing, and a short partner playbook. who can own the webinar ops?
elaine: I can run webinar ops. prefer Wed 6/18 or Thu 6/19 evenings PST. will need speaker + a short demo script.
jules: I can do speaker and demo. recommend a 20m demo + 20m q/a. make the demo focused on latency/cost comparison on typical customer workload.
samir: For the benchmark narrative, let's avoid just "X is faster" — frame it as "same quality, predictable cost at scale". we should include token-cost-per-req, p95 latency, and a short methodology section. also include model variants used and dataset prompts.
vikram: good call. Elaine, can you coordinate a short benchmark brief from Eng-ML? need numbers by EOD Tue (6/3) to feed the blog draft.
elaine: pinged eng-ml. @marketbot created a ticket: CSHP-214. will chase.
marketbot: incident-bot: Ticket CSHP-214 created and assigned to eng-ml-bench.
rachel: inbound lead routing note — CloudShelf wants leads to go into our SFDC partner queue with utm_source=cloudshelf and a webhook to their partner portal. i'll draft the mapping and a sample webhook payload.
jules: sample webhook mapping please, Rachel. we need schema for MQL -> opportunity kickoffs.
rachel: here is the example payload we'll ask partners to call:```json
{
  "source": "cloudshelf",
  "email": "demo@customer.com",
  "utm_campaign": "cloudshelf-launch",
  "lead_score": "75",
  "tags": ["marketplace","cloudshelf"]
}
```
elaine: For the landing page & launch post, marketing wants 500–700 words + 2 charts from the benchmark. draft due Fri 6/6. can we have a hero quote from CloudShelf?
vikram: Yes, ask CloudShelf for a short quote. i'll request it. also, let's plan a quick internal playbook doc: 1) who to @ for sales handoff, 2) lead SLAs (24h), 3) canned follow-ups. minimal, bullet format.
samir: Tagging the technical appendix owners: eng-runtime for runtime config used, eng-ml for bench methodology, and devrel for demo artifacts.
jules: webinar slide checklist: title slide, problem statement, demo (with reproducible steps), benchmark highlights, customer adoption examples, CTA + sign-up link.
elaine: can we add a tiny paid social budget to promote the webinar? $2k to test LinkedIn sponsored content for target accounts.
vikram: approved. we'll set up a UTM matrix for tracking: utm_source=cloudshelf, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudshelf-launch.
rachel: routing rules I'll propose: if lead_score >= 70 -> AE follow-up within 24h, else -> SDR nurture track. will share SFDC workflow export tomorrow.
jules: slated tasks and owners: benchmark brief — eng-ml (samir) by 6/3; blog draft — marketing (elaine) by 6/6; webinar ops — elaine by 6/12; demo + speaker — jules by 6/10; webhook spec — rachel by 6/4.
elaine: I'll run a calendar invite draft and share slides folder. also need logo assets and partner legal approval for quotes.
vikram: thanks all. short weekly sync on Tuesdays 9am PT starting next week. if blockers pop up, drop here. :rocket:
